subject: Kickoff: evidence roster & MAP timeline for GCS Health
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gcshealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: evidence roster & MAP timeline for GCS Health

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we’d like to kick off a mutual action plan (MAP) to stitch together GCS Health’s SOC 2 evidence and our evaluation timeline so both teams have clear owners and deadlines.

Attached are two starter artifacts: a short MAP skeleton and a SOC 2 evidence roster template. They’re intentionally lightweight — we’ll iterate them during the first sync. High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm your primary GRC point of contact for evidence collection (name + email + best timezone)
- Confirm procurement contact for DocuSign/review cycles
- Flag any hard dates (board reviews, go-live windows) that we should honor in the timeline

Proposed MAP cadence and timeline (suggested):
- Week 0 (this week): agree on owners + finalize roster template
- Week 1–4: evidence collection (owners upload items to shared Drive)
- Week 5–6: Redwood evaluation / follow-ups / gap remediation
- Week 7: close / final sign-off

Can you confirm whether this cadence looks reasonable? If helpful, we can start with a 30-minute kickoff this week — Wed or Thu mornings PT work well for our team.

Attachments: MAP_Skeleton_GCS_20261218.docx, SOC2_Evidence_Roster_Template.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gcshealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Lopez <martin.lopez@gcshealth.com>, procurement@gcshealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evidence roster & MAP timeline for GCS Health

Vanessa —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear plan. Martin Lopez (cc’d) will be our primary GRC lead for the SOC 2 evidence collection; he’ll own uploads to our side. Procurement (procurement@gcshealth.com) will handle contract/DocuSign review.

We completed a quick pass on the roster template and attached our onboarding form for your intake. The proposed cadence looks reasonable to us, though Martin will confirm availability for a standing weekly sync.

Can we meet for a 30-minute kickoff on Thursday 12/20 at 10:00 AM PT? If not, Friday morning also works.

Attachments: GCS_Onboarding_Form.pdf

Best,
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Security | GCS Health
emily.zhang@gcshealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 12:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: evidence roster & MAP timeline for GCS Health

Forwarding Emily’s note and adding a quick internal runbook so we’re aligned before the kickoff.

Internal owners (proposed):
- Evidence collection lead (audit artifacts, policies): Martin (GCS) — confirm
- Network/infra diagrams & logs: Laura Bennett (Redwood) — I’ll ask Laura to prep the template questions
- Data handling/KMS questions: Priyom Das — I’ll own follow-ups on disk/encryption/KMS mapping

Pre-kickoff tasks (for us):
1) Share our Evidence_Playbook.md with GCS (short checklist + typical artifact examples)
2) Populate the MAP skeleton with proposed Redwood deliverables and check points
3) Confirm standing sync cadence and calendar invite once Emily confirms times

A couple of questions to surface to Emily during kickoff:
- Do they have a centralized S3 or on-prem archive we should request evidence from?
- Who manages their KMS/CMK and is cross-account access required?

I’ve attached our Evidence_Playbook.md for reference. I’ll also draft a short folder structure in Drive under the link Vanessa shared.

Attachments: Evidence_Playbook.md

– Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior GRC Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gcshealth.com>, Martin Lopez <martin.lopez@gcshealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evidence roster & MAP timeline for GCS Health

Emily / Martin —

Appreciate the quick reply and for looping Martin/procurement. To make the timeline concrete, here’s our proposed MAP milestones (we’ll finalize on the kickoff):
- Dec 23: initial kickoff (30m) and finalization of MAP owners
- Dec 24 — Jan 21: evidence collection window (4 weeks)
- Jan 22 — Feb 4: Redwood evaluation, follow-ups, and remediation tasks (2 weeks)
- Week of Feb 8: target sign-off and close

Notes / asks:
- Please confirm any blackout dates over the next six weeks (holiday availability OK to flag)
- If a requested artifact is unavailable, we’ll log a short remediation plan and a single extension request (max 1 week)
- For data handling questions, we need a point of contact for KMS and for retention/backup policies

Operational items we’ll action after kickoff:
- Create shared Drive folder and baseline file structure (Vanessa will share link)
- Post kickoff: upload Redwood templates + evidence playbook to Drive
- Generate a DocuSign envelope for the MAP SOW and send to procurement (link below)

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/drive/gcs-onboarding/, https://docusign.com/secure/links/GCS-2026-112

If that timeline looks OK we can lock the weekly 30-minute sync — I propose Wednesdays at 10:00 AM PT starting Dec 23.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Reliability & Compliance Ops | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gcshealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Lopez <martin.lopez@gcshealth.com>, procurement@gcshealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: evidence roster & MAP timeline for GCS Health

Thanks, all — confirming a few points:
- Martin will be lead for GRC evidence and will coordinate uploads into the Drive folder. He’ll also be the primary on weekly syncs.
- Procurement will begin DocuSign review tomorrow; they expect to complete internal review within 3 business days.
- We have a slightly reduced engineering cadence the week of 12/27; Martin will flag if a particular artifact will slip past the collection window.

Kickoff: Thursday 12/24 is a little tight for our calendar, so we’ll take Sergio’s suggestion and make the first standing sync Wednesday 12/23 at 10:00 AM PT. Martin will send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Signed_Onboarding_Form.pdf

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Emily
